properties.name: TargetFramework
properties.doc: The framework the project targets.

properties.name: TargetFrameworks
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated frameworks of a multi-targeted project: every one of them is built.

properties.name: OutputType
properties.doc: What is built: a console application, a Windows application without a console, or a library.

properties.name: Nullable
properties.doc: Nullable reference types: annotations and warnings of the compiler.

properties.name: ImplicitUsings
properties.doc: Global usings the SDK adds for its kind of project (System, System.Linq, ...).

properties.name: LangVersion
properties.doc: The C# language version. By default it is the one of the target framework.

properties.name: RootNamespace
properties.doc: The namespace new files and embedded resources start with. By default the name of the project.

properties.name: AssemblyName
properties.doc: The name of the output assembly. By default the name of the project.

properties.name: Version
properties.doc: The version of the assembly and of the package: VersionPrefix-VersionSuffix unless set.

properties.name: VersionPrefix
properties.doc: The numeric part of the version, 1.0.0 by default.

properties.name: VersionSuffix
properties.doc: The prerelease label of the version, e.g. beta.1.

properties.name: AssemblyVersion
properties.doc: AssemblyVersionAttribute: what the runtime binds to.

properties.name: FileVersion
properties.doc: AssemblyFileVersionAttribute: the version the file properties show.

properties.name: InformationalVersion
properties.doc: AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute: the product version, the commit hash is appended to it.

properties.name: IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion
properties.doc: Append +<commit> to InformationalVersion.

properties.name: Configurations
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated build configurations of the project, Debug;Release by default.

properties.name: Platforms
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated platforms of the project, AnyCPU by default.

properties.name: PlatformTarget
properties.doc: The processor architecture the assembly is compiled for.

properties.name: Prefer32Bit
properties.doc: Run an AnyCPU executable as a 32-bit process where possible.

properties.name: AllowUnsafeBlocks
properties.doc: Allow the unsafe keyword.

properties.name: CheckForOverflowUnderflow
properties.doc: Integer arithmetic throws on overflow unless in an unchecked context.

properties.name: Deterministic
properties.doc: The same sources produce byte-for-byte the same assembly.

properties.name: Optimize
properties.doc: Compiler optimizations; on in Release.

properties.name: DebugType
properties.doc: The kind of debug information.

properties.name: DebugSymbols
properties.doc: Produce debug symbols.

properties.name: DefineConstants
properties.doc: Conditional compilation symbols; keep the inherited ones with $(DefineConstants);MY_SYMBOL.

properties.name: GenerateDocumentationFile
properties.doc: Write the XML documentation file next to the assembly (and enable the warnings about missing comments).

properties.name: DocumentationFile
properties.doc: The path of the XML documentation file.

properties.name: NoWarn
properties.doc: Diagnostics to suppress; keep the inherited ones with $(NoWarn);CS1591.

properties.name: TreatWarningsAsErrors
properties.doc: Every warning fails the build.

properties.name: WarningsAsErrors
properties.doc: Diagnostics that fail the build; nullable stands for all the nullable warnings.

properties.name: WarningsNotAsErrors
properties.doc: Diagnostics that stay warnings under TreatWarningsAsErrors.

properties.name: WarningLevel
properties.doc: The warning level of the compiler; 9999 is every warning of the future versions too.

properties.name: OutputPath
properties.doc: Where the build output goes, bin\$(Configuration)\ by default.

properties.name: BaseOutputPath
properties.doc: The root of the build output, bin\ by default.

properties.name: BaseIntermediateOutputPath
properties.doc: The root of the intermediate files, obj\ by default. Has to be set before the SDK props: in Directory.Build.props.

properties.name: IntermediateOutputPath
properties.doc: Where the intermediate files of the configuration go.

properties.name: AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath
properties.doc: Add the target framework to the output path.

properties.name: AppendRuntimeIdentifierToOutputPath
properties.doc: Add the runtime identifier to the output path.

properties.name: UseArtifactsOutput
properties.doc: One artifacts folder for the output of every project (SDK 8+). Set in Directory.Build.props.

properties.name: ArtifactsPath
properties.doc: The folder of UseArtifactsOutput, $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)artifacts by convention.

properties.name: GenerateAssemblyInfo
properties.doc: Generate the assembly attributes from the properties of the project.

properties.name: EnableDefaultItems
properties.doc: Include the files of the project folder by the globs of the SDK.

properties.name: EnableDefaultCompileItems
properties.doc: Include **/*.cs as Compile items.

properties.name: EnableDefaultEmbeddedResourceItems
properties.doc: Include **/*.resx as EmbeddedResource items.

properties.name: EnableDefaultNoneItems
properties.doc: Include the other files as None items.

properties.name: DefaultItemExcludes
properties.doc: Globs left out of the default items; keep the inherited ones with $(DefaultItemExcludes);**/*.tmp.

properties.name: IsPackable
properties.doc: dotnet pack makes a package of the project.

properties.name: IsPublishable
properties.doc: dotnet publish of a solution publishes the project.

properties.name: IsTestProject
properties.doc: dotnet test runs the project.

properties.name: StartupObject
properties.doc: The type with the Main method to start, when there are several.

properties.name: ApplicationIcon
properties.doc: The .ico file of the executable.

properties.name: ApplicationManifest
properties.doc: The Win32 manifest of the executable.

properties.name: NeutralLanguage
properties.doc: The culture of the resources in the main assembly, e.g. en-US.

properties.name: SatelliteResourceLanguages
properties.doc: Cultures whose satellite assemblies are kept, e.g. en;ru: drops the rest that packages bring.

properties.name: InvariantGlobalization
properties.doc: Run without culture data (no ICU): smaller, and every culture behaves as invariant.

properties.name: ServerGarbageCollection
properties.doc: Server GC: a heap per core, for throughput.

properties.name: ConcurrentGarbageCollection
properties.doc: Background GC.

properties.name: TieredCompilation
properties.doc: Quick JIT first, optimized code for hot methods later.

properties.name: TieredPGO
properties.doc: Dynamic profile-guided optimization.

properties.name: RollForward
properties.doc: Which newer runtime an application may run on when its own is not installed.

properties.name: UseAppHost
properties.doc: Produce the native executable that starts the application.

properties.name: RuntimeIdentifier
properties.doc: The platform the application is built for.

properties.name: RuntimeIdentifiers
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated platforms the project can be restored for.

properties.name: SelfContained
properties.doc: Ship the runtime with the application.

properties.name: CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies
properties.doc: Copy the assemblies of the packages to the output; for plugins and for libraries loaded by reflection.

properties.name: ProduceReferenceAssembly
properties.doc: Produce a reference assembly, so that a change of implementation does not rebuild the dependents.

properties.name: SignAssembly
properties.doc: Give the assembly a strong name.

properties.name: AssemblyOriginatorKeyFile
properties.doc: The .snk key of the strong name.

properties.name: PublicSign
properties.doc: Sign with the public key only.

properties.name: DelaySign
properties.doc: Reserve the place of the signature, sign later.

properties.name: DisableImplicitFrameworkReferences
properties.doc: Do not reference the shared framework implicitly.

properties.name: DisableTransitiveProjectReferences
properties.doc: A project sees only the projects it references itself.

properties.name: GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles
properties.doc: Write runtimeconfig.json for a library too: for tools that load it, such as dotnet ef.

properties.name: EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles
properties.doc: Write what the source generators produce to disk.

properties.name: CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath
properties.doc: The folder of EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles, obj/.../generated by default.

properties.name: InterceptorsNamespaces
properties.doc: Namespaces whose interceptors the compiler accepts (source generators of ASP.NET, EF, configuration binding).

properties.name: EnablePreviewFeatures
properties.doc: Allow the APIs and language features marked as preview.

properties.name: EnableWindowsTargeting
properties.doc: Build a Windows-targeted project on another OS.

properties.name: AccelerateBuildsInVisualStudio
properties.doc: Skip the build of up-to-date referenced projects in Visual Studio.

properties.name: EnableConfigurationBindingGenerator
properties.doc: Bind configuration with a source generator instead of reflection (trimming, AOT).

properties.name: EnableRequestDelegateGenerator
properties.doc: Compile minimal API handlers with a source generator (trimming, AOT).

properties.name: MSBuildTreatWarningsAsErrors
properties.doc: Warnings of MSBuild itself (MSB...) fail the build.

properties.name: MSBuildWarningsAsMessages
properties.doc: MSBuild and NuGet warnings to demote to messages, e.g. NU1701.

commonMetadata.name: CopyToOutputDirectory
commonMetadata.doc: Copy the file to the output folder.

commonMetadata.name: CopyToPublishDirectory
commonMetadata.doc: Copy the file to the publish folder.

commonMetadata.name: Link
commonMetadata.doc: The path the file is shown at and copied to, for a file outside of the project folder.

commonMetadata.name: LinkBase
commonMetadata.doc: The folder linked files of a glob are placed under.

commonMetadata.name: DependentUpon
commonMetadata.doc: The file this one is nested under in the solution view.

commonMetadata.name: Visible
commonMetadata.doc: Show the item in the solution view.

commonMetadata.name: Pack
commonMetadata.doc: Include the file in the NuGet package.

commonMetadata.name: PackagePath
commonMetadata.doc: Where in the package the file goes; empty or \ is the root.

commonMetadata.name: Generator
commonMetadata.doc: The single-file generator of the file, e.g. ResXFileCodeGenerator.

commonMetadata.name: LastGenOutput
commonMetadata.doc: The file the generator has produced.

commonMetadata.name: ExcludeFromSingleFile
commonMetadata.doc: Keep the file next to a single-file application instead of inside it.

commonMetadata.name: TargetPath
commonMetadata.doc: The path of the copy relative to the output folder.

items.name: Compile
items.doc: Source files for the compiler. The SDK includes **/*.cs itself: Remove and Update are what is usually needed.

items.name: Content
items.doc: Files that go along with the application: copied on publish, packed into contentFiles.

items.name: None
items.doc: Files that take no part in the build, unless their metadata says so.

items.name: EmbeddedResource
items.doc: Files embedded into the assembly.

metadata.name: LogicalName
metadata.doc: The name of the manifest resource; by default the namespace plus the path.

metadata.name: WithCulture
metadata.doc: Treat the part of the file name before the extension as a culture.

items.name: AdditionalFiles
items.doc: Files passed to analyzers and source generators: stylecop.json, BannedSymbols.txt, PublicAPI.Shipped.txt.

items.name: EditorConfigFiles
items.doc: Extra .editorconfig / .globalconfig files for the compiler.

items.name: GlobalAnalyzerConfigFiles
items.doc: Global analyzer configuration files (.globalconfig).

items.name: Using
items.doc: A global using directive for every file of the project.

metadata.name: Static
metadata.doc: global using static.

metadata.name: Alias
metadata.doc: global using Alias = Include.

items.name: InternalsVisibleTo
items.doc: InternalsVisibleToAttribute for the assembly named in Include: the tests, the mocking library (DynamicProxyGenAssembly2).

metadata.name: Key
metadata.doc: The public key of a strong-named friend assembly.

items.name: AssemblyAttribute
items.doc: An assembly-level attribute; Include is the full type name.

metadata.name: _Parameter1
metadata.doc: The first constructor argument.

metadata.name: _Parameter2
metadata.doc: The second constructor argument.

metadata.name: _Parameter1_TypeName
metadata.doc: The type of the first argument when it is not a string.

items.name: AssemblyMetadata
items.doc: AssemblyMetadataAttribute: Include is the key.

metadata.name: Value
metadata.doc: The value of the key.

items.name: ProjectReference
items.doc: A reference to another project of the solution.

metadata.name: ReferenceOutputAssembly
metadata.doc: false: build the project first, but do not reference its assembly.

metadata.name: OutputItemType
metadata.doc: What the output of the project becomes here: Analyzer for a source generator.

metadata.name: PrivateAssets
metadata.doc: What of the reference does not flow to the consumers of this project.

metadata.name: IncludeAssets
metadata.doc: What of the reference is used.

metadata.name: ExcludeAssets
metadata.doc: What of the reference is not used.

metadata.name: Private
metadata.doc: Copy the assembly of the project to the output.

metadata.name: SetTargetFramework
metadata.doc: The framework of a multi-targeted project to take: TargetFramework=netstandard2.0.

metadata.name: SkipGetTargetFrameworkProperties
metadata.doc: Do not negotiate the target framework with the referenced project.

metadata.name: Aliases
metadata.doc: extern alias for the types of the project.

items.name: PackageReference
items.doc: A NuGet package.

metadata.name: Version
metadata.doc: The version or a range: 1.2.3, 1.*, [1.0,2.0). Not set here under central package management.

metadata.name: VersionOverride
metadata.doc: A version for this project only, under central package management.

metadata.name: PrivateAssets
metadata.doc: What of the package does not flow to the consumers of this project; all for analyzers and build tools.

metadata.name: IncludeAssets
metadata.doc: What of the package is used.
values: runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers; buildtransitive

metadata.name: ExcludeAssets
metadata.doc: What of the package is not used.

metadata.name: GeneratePathProperty
metadata.doc: Define $(PkgPackage_Id) with the folder of the package.

metadata.name: NoWarn
metadata.doc: NuGet warnings to suppress for the package, e.g. NU1701.

metadata.name: Aliases
metadata.doc: extern alias for the types of the package.

items.name: Reference
items.doc: An assembly referenced by name or by path.

metadata.name: HintPath
metadata.doc: The path of the assembly.

metadata.name: Private
metadata.doc: Copy the assembly to the output.

metadata.name: SpecificVersion
metadata.doc: Require exactly the version of Include.

metadata.name: Aliases
metadata.doc: extern alias for the types of the assembly.

items.name: FrameworkReference
items.doc: A shared framework: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App, Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App.

items.name: Analyzer
items.doc: An analyzer or source generator assembly.

items.name: Folder
items.doc: An empty folder kept in the solution view.

items.name: Watch
items.doc: Extra files dotnet watch reacts to.

items.name: SupportedPlatform
items.doc: A platform the platform compatibility analyzer assumes: browser, windows, linux.

items.name: TrimmerRootAssembly
items.doc: An assembly the trimmer keeps whole.

items.name: TrimmerRootDescriptor
items.doc: An XML file that tells the trimmer what to keep.

items.name: RuntimeHostConfigurationOption
items.doc: A runtimeconfig.json knob (AppContext switch); Include is its name.

metadata.name: Value
metadata.doc: The value of the knob.

metadata.name: Trim
metadata.doc: Let the trimmer treat the value as a constant.
